purpose: Home composition redesign after user feedback; gameplay UI remains unchanged
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished portrait mobile match-3 game HOME SCREEN redesign, approximately 9:16 ratio, full bleed, no phone hardware and no surrounding presentation board. The supplied screenshot is a NEGATIVE layout reference and a reference only for required functions and existing realistic mushroom theme. Recompose decisively.
The game is 菌子消消乐, a casual match-3 puzzle using realistic mushrooms, NOT a foraging, hiking, farming or exploration simulator. Premium polished casual mobile-game art, grounded semi-realistic forest scenery, natural photographed-material detail translated into carefully art-directed game illustration. Clear game controls with refined tactile edges and soft highlights. No browser/page/dashboard appearance.
Composition: a fresh, sunlit, inviting woodland clearing seen with a modest downward camera angle. Distant blue-green mountain haze only in the upper quarter, a large coherent moss-covered rock and red-earth clearing in the middle/lower screen, fern and pine-needle accents to the sides. Calm central background, crisp controlled foreground. No giant mushrooms, fairy village, characters or new features. Mushroom and pine-cone details small and realistic. The ground must be visible below the level markers so their contact shadows make spatial sense.
At top, one compact even HUD row: a small realistic green mushroom avatar in a softly rounded frame, a red heart with exact text "30 / 30", a warm gold coin with exact number "0", and a compact menu button. Warm ivory counter faces, slim dark evergreen rims, modest depth, no excessive stacked bevels. Keep generous clear spacing. At upper center, moderately sized dimensional ivory/gold Chinese logo exact text "菌子消消乐", dark evergreen edges, small brown mushroom details, occupying about 42 percent of screen width, not a giant banner.
Central game content: ONLY TWO level markers, level "1" current and level "2" locked. No other level numbers or fake rewards. Make a short gently curved path physically laid over the clearing. The smaller locked marker "2" at about 43 percent screen height is a restrained sage-stone soft square with a small brass lock; it connects down to the current level group at about 64 percent screen height. The CURRENT LEVEL AND PLAY ACTION form ONE unified hero object: a handsome rounded rectangular warm-ivory enamel game plaque on a restrained moss-green base with believable thickness and contact shadow, exact "第 1 关" prominent above an integrated rich amber-gold lower button labeled "开始游戏" with a small play triangle. This whole group about 58 percent screen width and 19 percent screen height. Bright warm amber is the single strong action accent against the cool forest. DO NOT draw a huge lime-green circular disk, don't place a separate detached long CTA near the bottom, don't repeat the current level number elsewhere. No text "当前关卡".
Bottom navigation, about 9 percent screen height: one restrained compact deep-evergreen ledge with a thin warm-ivory top edge, three generous clickable zones. Exactly three labels "商店", "游戏", "图鉴", with readable warm-ivory text and substantial matching realistic game icons: small wooden shop with sage awning, realistic mushroom cluster, open field-guide book. Selected center tab receives a soft amber arch/backplate and slightly enlarged icon, not an orb, no thick multi-ring badge. Icons and labels should feel designed together, not tiny clipart glued onto a big bar.
Color control: cool pine green and gentle teal in background, warm ivory interface faces, restrained gold for reward and primary action, red only for heart. Rich contrast without gray fog covering everything; clear focal hierarchy and attractive color separation. Consistent single light direction. High quality compact silhouettes, deliberate detailed craft, no thin vector line icons, no generic UI cards, no floating green coins, no neon green gradients, no huge blank gap, no activity icons around the sides, no collection narrative.
Render the entire screen as a plausible beautiful game screenshot with clean legible Chinese labels, sharp polished controls and balanced composition.
